name: Rizwan Shah
role: RAW operative — Hamza's right-hand man in Film 2
real_life_inspiration: Pure composite — no specific real-world parallel. Represents the younger generation of post-2014 'Naya Bharat' operatives authorised to act offensively under the new doctrine.

inspiration_notes.archetype: The film uses Rizwan as a contrast to Hamza's decade-long patient deep-cover approach. Rizwan represents the post-2014 offensive posture — less patience, more direct action, authorised by the new political mandate.
inspiration_notes.relationship_to_hamza: Right-hand operative. Not a replacement — they work in tandem in Film 2's revenge arc, each handling different threads of the Major Iqbal / 26/11 planner targeting operation.
